mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, o.wo_no, e.name AS equipment_name FROM mes_mold t LEFT JOIN mes_work_order o ON o.id = t.wo_id LEFT JOIN mes_equipment e ON e.id = t.equipment_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mes_mold WHERE wo_id = #{woId} AND status = 'IN_USE' ORDER BY code

SELECT p.mold_id AS "moldId", p.material_id AS "materialId", m.code AS "code", m.name AS "name" FROM mes_mold_product p JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id WHERE p.mold_id IN #{id} ORDER BY p.mold_id, m.code
mapper.update: UPDATE mes_mold SET used_count = used_count + #{shots}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT l.*, o.wo_no, e.name AS equipment_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM mes_mold_log l LEFT JOIN mes_work_order o ON o.id = l.wo_id LEFT JOIN mes_equipment e ON e.id = l.equipment_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.create_by WHERE l.mold_id = #{moldId} ORDER BY l.id DESC
